# ESLint interoperability fixture

`results.sarif` was generated by ESLint 10.14.0 with the `no-eval` rule,
`@typescript-eslint/parser` 8.72.1 and `@microsoft/eslint-formatter-sarif` 3.1.0,
using Node 24.21.0. Both source files are synthetic and were parsed, not executed.
Only the producer's absolute artifact URIs were changed to relative filenames so
the fixture can run on other machines. Result messages, rule metadata and coordinates
were retained; no artifact hashes or data-flow claims were added.

The two rule matches check import compatibility. They are not confirmed vulnerabilities
or a test of source-to-sink detection quality. Missing producer hashes deliberately
leave source-version status unverified, blocking automatic triage.
